g.text: Depth alone does not determine solution quality
5 graphs | 3 starts per graph | 15 final evaluations per point | shaded bands: SD of graph means
Baselines: exact optimum (dotted), greedy (green dashed), random expected cut (brown dashed). Bands are descriptive, not confidence intervals.
